Mt. Gox Delays Creditor Repayment Deadline to 2027 for Fourth Straight Year

Mt. Gox, once the world's largest Bitcoin exchange before its collapse in 2014 following a major theft, has extended its creditor repayment deadline by another year to October 31, 2027, marking the fourth consecutive annual extension since 2023. Court-appointed rehabilitation trustee Nobuaki Kobayashi said repayments have largely been completed for creditors who fulfilled the required procedures without issues, but many remain unpaid due to incomplete documentation or processing problems. — link

Ethereum Sets October 26 for Glamsterdam Upgrade on Hoodi Testnet, Raising Gas Limit to 200 Million

The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam upgrade will activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26 at 17:42 UTC, raising its block gas limit to 200 million, matching Sepolia. Hyperliquid Policy Center urges SEC to refine airdrop, secondary trading rules

Hyperliquid Policy Center submitted comments on the SEC’s proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, calling for clearer treatment of free token airdrops, broader secondary trading for exempt tokens, expanded safe harbors and clearer rules for token buybacks. The SEC proposal includes exemptions for startup token offerings of up to $5 million over four years and qualifying fundraising of up to $75 million in any 12-month period. — link

Superplanet is intended to serve as Metaplanet’s U.S.-listed Bitcoin treasury platform, while related warrants could provide up to roughly $3.4 billion in additional equity capital. — link
